segments.speaker: Aman
segments.text: Kavya, tell us about a system you designed recently.

segments.speaker: Kavya
segments.text: I built an event pipeline on Kafka that handled about two million events a day for order tracking.

segments.speaker: Ritu
segments.text: How did you deal with duplicate events?

segments.speaker: Kavya
segments.text: Every consumer was idempotent, keyed by order ID and event version, so replays were safe.

segments.speaker: Aman
segments.text: What would you change if you built it again?

segments.speaker: Kavya
segments.text: I would add a schema registry earlier. We broke consumers twice with field renames.

segments.speaker: Ritu
segments.text: Strong answers. I think we should move Kavya to the system design round.

segments.speaker: Ritu
segments.text: I will schedule the system design round for next week.

segments.speaker: Aman
segments.text: I will write up my feedback by tomorrow.
